description: Every overlap and inclusion composition of the Bokut-Shiao-completed Hecke rewriting system reduces to zero at every rank from 2 to 12, and the Bokut-Shiao-against-Bokut-Shiao corner obeys two exact closed-form regimes in the two depths. Exact over Z[h], h = q - q^-1; no float is formed.
caveats: Computational witness, not a proof. It establishes that the obligation set is discharge-able at every rank tested and measures the shape of the corner family; it proves nothing for n > 12, and the closed forms are fitted-and-checked, not derived.

The rule set, S-polynomial conventions and reduction strategy are imported unchanged from hecke_gs_confluence_n4.py; faithfulness to the Lean definitions rests on that script's docstring table, checked by inspection rather than mechanically.
